svg.title: TRACI Hook Cam - Camera and Height Sensor - 2 of 3
svg.desc: Revision v3. Original master hook restored on page 1 at 18 percent opacity. Native editable SVG text and layout, embedded replaceable raster product images. Three-page datasheet; references maintained separately.

g.text: Core hardware for video capture and distance measurement.
microSD card slot, up to 512 GB
PoE or 12-24 V DC via 5525 barrel jack
USB Type-C OTG; 2 x CAN; 2 x GPIO
69 x 41.5 x 26 mm; 50 g with cable
Sensor range depends on target reflectivity and viewing conditions. Manufacturer accuracy is specified on a 90% reflective target at
25 °C. Height reference depends on sensor alignment and mounting position.
